_comment: Financial-year super parameters. charge_percentage is SGAA s 17A(2). max_contributions_base is annual per employer from 1 Jul 2026 (s 10A(5): concessional cap x 100 / charge percentage, rounded down to the nearest $10), where it was quarterly under the old law.

2026-27.source: ATO maximum contributions base and contributions caps pages, read as search-result snippets rather than fetched directly (ato.gov.au blocks automated fetching). The figure checks out against the statutory formula: 32500 x 100 / 12, rounded down to the nearest $10.
